name: better-auth-native-hooks
reason: These provider-specific Effect callbacks preserve Better Auth's hook parameters and results, including the caller's native provider options.

name: better-auth-native-test-context
reason: Provider integration tests supply a real Better Auth instance, its test plugin context and its native migration options.

name: native-typescript-rule-analysis
reason: Quality rule inputs and helpers expose native TypeScript programs, nodes, symbols and checkers so custom analysis composes with the compiler without a second AST model.

name: native-react-components-and-contexts
reason: React components, providers and contexts retain native ReactNode and Context types so applications use the renderer directly.

name: native-vitest-rerun-state
reason: The Vitest plugin merges runner attempts and snapshots through native Vitest test modules, state and snapshot environments.

name: native-vitest-app-config
reason: The Vitest application configuration builder preserves the native Vite configuration accepted by Vitest, including Vite plugin types.

name: native-browser-story-rendering
reason: Browser stories mount application React trees, so the public render callback accepts native ReactNode values.

name: native-react-admin-views
reason: The built-in admin views are React components whose props and results are native React types, so applications mount them in their own admin shell.

name: native-claude-sdk-messages
reason: These Effect mappers read the Claude Agent SDK's own message, option and usage types, so a scripted provider and the real SDK feed the same mapping.

name: native-pi-session-events
reason: These Effect mappers read the pi coding agent's own session event and message types.

name: native-react-number-input
reason: numberInput reads native React input events, so a number field binds to a plain input element.

name: better-auth-native-options
reason: These modules assemble Better Auth options, plugins, seeds and schema checks for the caller's own Better Auth instance, so their signatures carry Better Auth's option and schema types.

name: native-router-pending-screen
reason: The pending-screen readout takes the application's own TanStack Router instance to see whether a route is still mounting.

name: native-vitest-test-output
reason: The TestOutput service holds Vitest's own silent setting for the application's test configuration.
